name: Pell
description: Eleven, Shoals-born, one of the quay children who carry messages for a copper. Kag's runner since she started paying in food instead of coin. Small, fast, known by sight on every jetty between the ice-houses and the Fishmarket bridge. he/him.
actor_notes:
Pell
LOOKS: Eleven. Small for it, all knees, sun-bleached hair cut with a knife, bare feet with the soles of a man of forty. A man's shirt with the sleeves cut off at the shoulder.
CORE: A child who worked out very early that being useful is the only protection available to him, and who has never once been wrong about that, which is the problem.
NATURE: Cheerful, relentless, physically incapable of sitting still. Talks while doing something else, usually with his hands in whatever is nearest. Enormous appetite. Laughs at his own jokes before he finishes them.
WOUND: Nobody has ever given him a job he could fail at without being got rid of, so he has no idea what a refusal is for and will agree to things that frighten him.
WANTS: To be given the hard half of it rather than the errand.
PRESSURE: He gets faster and more agreeable. He will not say he is frightened; he will say yes sooner.
KEY: "I know him. I know where he eats."
